Interface JsonBackend

All Known Implementing Classes:
ForjBackend
public interface JsonBackend
Makes readers and writers: the one thing a JSON parser plugs in. Codecs are written against JsonReader and JsonWriter only, so any backend runs any codec.

The backend is a given. forj's own is declared here, next to the type, so it's the default wherever nothing closer is in scope; an app, a class or a single method swaps it with its own given JsonBackend backend = ...;. There is no service lookup.
